author: Da_Baus
body:
Hello Avicus staff.
I was banned for hacking on your servers and I know that what I did was wrong and I have no idea why I did it, but I can promise that it will never happen again. I know that this I'm sorry stuff won't cut it but I am truly sorry and I wasted your time when you could have been doing stuff that was very important or fun, I know that I had disappointed everyone when I hacked and I shouldn't have done it. I really would love to come back into the developed community that is Avicus and meet old friends and create new ones. Once again I am truly sorry this will never happen again.

Thanks for reading 
-Raxay

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I will appeal this ban. You seem sorry for your actions, and have taken full responsibility, I like to see that. If you ever hack again, you'll have no chance of being appealed. Don't make me regret this decision. 

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
